data.long_meaning: The name Sherie is of uncertain origin. In English, it can be derived from the Old English word scirig, meaning 'noble, shining, pure'. In Greek, it can be derived from the word sheria, meaning 'ruler, princess'. The name Sherie carries the meaning “Lady, Princess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sherie usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, princess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
